answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable bond and build a verifiable work history before it can trade high-value goods such as saffron, copper parts, or ferrous tools. A single fake identity is cheap, but a Sybil swarm must pay a bond and spend time earning trust for each copy, so the attacker cost grows with every fake while honest agents pay only once. Identities caught cheating lose the bond, making large-scale fakery unprofitable.
